thessalonians1.1.p1.b1.text: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, To the church of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

thessalonians1.1.p2.b1.text: We always thank God for all of you, remembering you in our prayers

thessalonians1.1.p2.b2.text: and continually recalling before our God and Father your work of faith, your labor of love, and your enduring hope in our Lord Jesus Christ.

thessalonians1.1.p2.b3.text: because our gospel came to you not only in word, but also in power, in the Holy Spirit, and with great conviction …

thessalonians1.1.p2.b4.text: … you welcomed the message with the joy of the Holy Spirit, in spite of your great suffering.

thessalonians1.1.p3.b1.text: For not only did the message of the Lord ring out from you to Macedonia and Achaia, …

thessalonians1.1.p3.b2.text: For they themselves report what kind of welcome you gave us, …

thessalonians1.1.p3.b3.text: … and how you turned to God from idols to serve the living and true God

thessalonians1.1.p3.b4.text: and to await His Son from heaven, whom He raised from the dead—Jesus our deliverer from the coming wrath.
